IVC Logistics — Railway Freight Expense Details

Breakdown of freight charges per Railway Receipt (RR) Number · Data extracted from IVC Operations Database · Total: 2,945 records

📋 How to read this report

Every time IVC loads vehicles onto a train, Indian Railways issues a Railway Receipt (RR Number) — this is the official freight document. For each train dispatch, IVC records the freight/handling charge it owes (to loading/unloading contractors at origin/destination yards).

IVC Own Rakes (IVCLL-xx) — IVC's dedicated train wagons (e.g. IVCLL-08, IVCLL-11) — cost ₹66,000 per dispatch as a fixed labour charge.
Hired Rakes (PF-xx) — Rakes borrowed from other operators — cost ₹25,000 per dispatch.
Bill Group — Multiple RR numbers submitted together in one expense claim (e.g. Bill 3644 covered 5 train loads in July 2026).
